value.rationale: Size-bin filtration is a motivated measurement problem in the cited 2024 hydrology literature. A two-reversal observation under a fixed exponential size-class model forces a nonmonotone attenuation ordering and at least four distinct loss rates. The constrained, single-peaked ordered-rate region supplies a global two-turn cap with a strict positive witness and open-set persistence, allowing a scientifically meaningful structural diagnostic without assuming remobilization or fragmentation. Not field-calibrated; the limits are explicit.
